doc.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Closing thanks and living in San Diego
summary: Rowe thanks him. Magnusson says he loves living in San Diego, where he surfs and plays tennis.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well listen, I want to thank you for coming up after your gig.
Well it’s my pleasure to talk to you.
I’ll look forward to maybe getting down to San Diego, which seems to be a really nice town.
It’s a great place to live, I mean I’m prejudiced but I love living there, and I’m an ocean person, I do some surfing and I play tennis, so it’s a great place to be for those activities.
All right. Well thanks for your time.
